name: Natacha Altamirano
title: Senior Director, Data Science @ Birch Hill Equity Partners
bio: Prior to joining Birch Hill in 2019, Natacha received her Ph.D. in Theoretical Physics from the University of Waterloo and the Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics. Her research focused on black holes, quantum gravity, and cosmology, with an emphasis in data analysis of the cosmic microwave background and its interaction with galaxies.

name: Rue Sriharsha
title: Senior Consultant @ KPMG
bio: Rue is driven by a passion for leveraging AI and automation to create solutions that simplify and enhance everyday life. She is a Senior consultant at KPMG's Trusted AI practice, where she helps organizations navigate and implement effective AI governance to drive responsible innovation. She is a recipient of the Rising Star in AI award across North America. Prior to her current role, Rue worked at Microsoft, Amazon and Deloitte, and is a UofT alum.

name: Sunny Baek
title: Director of Integrated Risk Management & Technology @ SE Health
bio:
Sunny Baek is a registered nurse and digital health consultant who has built a non-traditional career at the intersection of STEM, healthcare, and business.
She began her career in IT, later trained as a registered nurse, and eventually transitioned into management consulting, where she worked with hospitals, public-sector organizations, and healthcare leaders on large-scale transformation initiatives. Her consulting experience includes clinical information system implementations, enterprise risk and safety modernization, and operational and financial reviews for complex healthcare organizations.
Sunny currently serves as Director of Integrated Risk Management & Technology at SE Health, where she leads organization-wide projects that connect clinical practice, technology, and strategy. Having worked both on the frontlines of patient care and in consulting environments, she brings a practical perspective on how STEM and clinical skills can be translated into impactful business and leadership roles.
She is passionate about helping students explore consulting and business careers beyond traditional paths, especially for those navigating uncertainty, career pivots, or non-linear journeys. Sunny enjoys mentoring students who are curious about how to turn technical expertise into meaningful system-level impact.

name: Cali Arantes
title: Partner Development Specialist @ Intuit
bio:
Cali Arantes is a business and technology professional at Intuit, working at the intersection of strategy, product, and innovation. She leverages analytical thinking to drive customer-centric outcomes and scalable growth.
At Intuit, Cali partners cross-functionally to translate technical concepts into clear, actionable business strategy, enabling data-driven decision-making and execution. Her career journey reflects a purposeful move into sales and business leadership, demonstrating how a strong technical foundation can unlock diverse opportunities across strategy, consulting-style roles, and commercial leadership.
